diagnostics.message: google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra registers the router appliance VMs with the NCC hub but has no ordering dependency on the BGP peers (peer_0) that establish sessions to those VMs. If the spoke is created before the Cloud Router interfaces/BGP sessions exist, the hub sees appliance instances with no active BGP sessions and connectivity cannot be established. Add depends_on so the BGP fabric is in place first.

google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra registers the router appliance VMs with the NCC hub but has no ordering dependency on the redundant BGP peers (peer_1). peer_1 transitively depends on intf_1 and google_compute_router.cr, so a depends_on here also ensures the full interface/router chain (and intf_0 via peer_0) precedes spoke creation. Without it, the spoke can be registered to the hub before the second BGP session exists.
